title: Red Team Operator
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Red Team Operator: Plan ethical adversary simulations with reconnaissance, initial access labs, privilege escalation, lateral movement, reporting, and purple-team learning.

tree.name: Foundational Knowledge & Environment Setup
tree.description: Establish a strong baseline with essential technical skills, cybersecurity principles, and the setup of a dedicated Red Team lab environment for practical learning.

resources.title: Ethical Hacking Course: Red Teaming For Beginners (q0phi80)

children.name: Introduction to Red Teaming & Core Concepts
children.description: Understand the Red Team operator role, its objectives, legal and ethical considerations, and the adversary emulation lifecycle. Differentiate between Red Team, Pen Testing, and Bug Bounty, and get introduced to the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.

resources.title: RED TEAMING explained in 8 Minutes (Mad Hat)
Red Team vs. Penetration Test: What's the Difference?

children.name: Essential Technical Fundamentals (OS, Networking, Scripting)
children.description: Gain proficiency in operating systems (Linux, Windows, Windows Server), networking protocols (TCP/IP stack, common services), and scripting for automation using Python, Bash, and PowerShell. Understand command-line interfaces and fundamental data structures.

resources.title: Linux Command Line Full Course for Beginners
Networking Basics for Hackers - Full Course

children.name: Core Security Principles & Threat Intelligence
children.description: Understand common attack vectors, vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), and various defensive mechanisms (AV, EDR, SIEM, Firewalls). Learn threat modeling methodologies and how to integrate threat intelligence into Red Team planning.

children.name: Red Team Lab Setup & Essential Tooling
children.description: Set up a virtualized lab environment (e.g., VMWare, VirtualBox, Proxmox) with diverse target machines (Windows 10/11, Windows Server, various Linux distributions) and attacker machines (Kali Linux, Parrot OS). Build a small Active Directory environment for practice and gain proficiency with foundational Red Team tools and version control (Git).

resources.title: Setting up an Ethical Hacking Lab (VirtualBox)
Building a Windows Domain Lab for Security Testing

tree.name: Red Team Engagement Lifecycle
tree.description: Master the complete phases of a Red Team operation, from meticulous planning and reconnaissance to achieving initial access, execution, sophisticated post-exploitation, and objective completion.

resources.title: Offensive Red Team Training: Live Adversary Attack Emulation | Hacker Associate

children.name: Engagement Planning & Rules of Engagement
children.description: Learn to define clear engagement objectives, scope, and rules of engagement (RoE). Understand legal and ethical boundaries, client communication, and expectation management for successful adversary simulations.

resources.title: The Art of Reconnaissance - OSINT Techniques
Creating Effective Rules of Engagement for Security Testing

children.name: Advanced Reconnaissance & OSINT
children.description: Master open-source intelligence (OSINT) techniques for passive reconnaissance and conduct targeted active reconnaissance using tools like Nmap, Shodan, Censys, and DNS/Subdomain enumeration for effective target profiling and vulnerability identification.

resources.title: Shodan - The Search Engine for the Internet of Things

children.name: Initial Access Vectors & Exploitation
children.description: Develop skills in gaining the initial foothold into a target environment. Explore various attack vectors including sophisticated social engineering (phishing, vishing), client-side exploits, public-facing application exploitation (web apps, APIs), and understanding basic vulnerability research concepts.

children.name: Execution & Command and Control (C2) Operations
children.description: Learn to establish and maintain resilient command and control channels. Understand various C2 frameworks (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Covenant), their operational security, custom payload development, and techniques for C2 evasion over diverse protocols (HTTP, DNS, SMB, ICMP).

resources.title: Understanding C2 Frameworks for Red Teams

children.name: Post-Exploitation & Internal Operations
children.description: Execute comprehensive post-exploitation actions: credential dumping (Mimikatz, LSASS), establishing persistence mechanisms (scheduled tasks, WMI, run keys), privilege escalation (kernel exploits, misconfigurations), lateral movement (PsExec, WMI, RDP, Pass-the-Hash), and advanced defense evasion tactics.

children.name: Data Exfiltration & Objective Completion
children.description: Focus on techniques for sensitive data exfiltration, achieving specific objectives (e.g., domain administrator, critical system access, intellectual property theft), and understanding the overall impact of the simulated breach from a business perspective.

resources.title: Simulating Impact in Red Team Engagements

tree.name: Advanced Topics, Reporting & Collaboration
tree.description: Dive into specialized Red Team operations, master effective reporting, and learn to collaborate with blue teams for enhanced security posture through Purple Teaming.

resources.title: Red Team Operations: A Practical Guide (Book)
Purple Teaming: Bridging the Gap Between Offense and Defense

children.name: Active Directory & Enterprise Environment Exploitation
children.description: Deep dive into Active Directory concepts, enumeration, common vulnerabilities, and advanced attack techniques like Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, Golden Ticket, Silver Ticket, DCsync, DCshadow, and BloodHound analysis for complex enterprise environments.

resources.title: Adversary Simulation Red Team Operations with BloodHound

children.name: Cloud Security Red Teaming
children.description: Explore Red Team operations in various cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). Understand common cloud misconfigurations, cloud-specific IAM attacks, serverless function exploitation, container escapes, and abusing cloud service misconfigurations and native tools for persistence and privilege escalation.

resources.title: Azure Red Teaming: Attacking Azure AD and Cloud Services

children.name: Operational Security (OpSec) & Advanced Tradecraft
children.description: Learn to manage and protect your Red Team infrastructure (C2 infrastructure design, redirectors, domain fronting), maintain stealth, and implement sophisticated evasion techniques to avoid detection by advanced defensive mechanisms (EDR, SIEM). Focus on custom payload development, anti-virus/EDR evasion, anti-forensics, and intelligence-driven emulation.

resources.title: Red Team Infrastructure: Essential OpSec Considerations

children.name: Red Team Reporting & Debriefing
children.description: Develop skills in writing clear, concise, and impactful Red Team reports. Learn to effectively communicate findings, risk assessments, actionable recommendations, and executive summaries to various stakeholders during debriefings, demonstrating strong presentation skills.

children.name: Purple Teaming & Remediation Strategies
children.description: Understand the principles of purple teaming, how to effectively collaborate with blue teams to improve detection and response capabilities, and assist in developing effective, prioritized remediation strategies based on identified TTPs and attack paths. Integrate threat hunting and TTP emulation.

resources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Purple Teaming

tree.name: Capstone Project & Professional Development
tree.description: Apply all learned skills in a comprehensive capstone project, build a strong professional portfolio, and prepare for career advancement as a Red Team Operator, fostering continuous learning.

resources.title: Building a Cybersecurity Portfolio (Certifications and Projects)

children.name: Full-Scope Red Team Engagement Capstone
children.description: Plan and execute a simulated end-to-end Red Team engagement, emulating real-world threat actors and their TTPs, from initial reconnaissance to objective completion and reporting, on a realistic target environment. Document the entire process, including TTPs, lessons learned, and defensive counteractions.

children.name: Portfolio Development & Case Study Writing
children.description: Curate a professional portfolio showcasing your Red Team skills through documented projects, detailed case studies (including TTPs and impact), CTF write-ups, blog posts, and contributions to the security community. Learn to articulate your experience effectively for interviews.

resources.title: How to Build a Cybersecurity Portfolio
Writing Effective Case Studies for Your Portfolio

children.name: Career Paths, Certifications & Interview Prep
children.description: Explore different career trajectories within Red Teaming and offensive security. Understand industry-recognized certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTP, CRT) and prepare for technical interviews. Focus on continuous learning and staying current with emerging threats and technologies.

resources.title: Red Team Interview Questions and Answers
